description: As traxx_td_timetable, from a cold start: the trainset stands with velocity 0, so the locomotive starts braked, its brake handle (MHZ_6P, with a time chamber) in the holding position and the brake pipe below running pressure. The driver gets the order to run as a train, starts the locomotive, puts the handle to running, charges the brake pipe and leaves on time.
